title: Build atomic models of CNx nitrogen sites
action: Construct periodic slab or cluster models for the eight CNx nitrogen functionalities (zigzag pyridinic, zigzag pyridinium, zigzag oxide, basal quaternary, armchair pyridinic, armchair pyridinium, armchair quaternary, armchair oxide) using standard carbon-nitrogen lattice parameters. Prepare input files for DFT geometry optimizations of all states (bare, protonated, OOH*, OH*, O*).
description: Process step to build all required atomic structure models and DFT input files; no scored output.
output_schema: Text file describing the constructed models, cell parameters, and location of input files.

title: Run DFT calculations for all states and sites
action: Using an open-source plane-wave DFT code with the PBE functional and a continuum solvation model, perform geometry optimizations and single-point energy calculations for each site in all relevant states (bare, protonated, OOH*, OH*, O*). For each optimized geometry, compute the N 1s core-level binding energy (e.g., via delta-SCF or equivalent method). Record converged total energies and binding energies.
description: Process step executing DFT simulations; generates raw energy and log files.
output_schema: Text log summarizing calculation convergence and raw energies.

title: Compile N 1s binding energies and shifts
action: Compile all computed N 1s binding energies (in eV) into a structured JSON file. For each site, report the binding energy for each state (bare, protonated, OOH*, OH*, O*) and compute the binding energy shift relative to the bare zigzag pyridinic reference (taken as 0.0 eV). Also report the shift due to protonation (E_bind(protonated)−E_bind(bare)) and the shifts due to each adsorbate relative to the bare state. Include only physically meaningful states for each site.
description: A JSON object mapping each site model to its computed binding energies for bare, protonated, and ORR-intermediate states, plus the computed shifts relative to the zigzag pyridinic reference.
output_schema: JSON object where each key is a site name (e.g., 'zigzag_pyridinic', 'basal_quaternary') and the value is an object with keys 'bare', 'protonated', 'OOH', 'OH', 'O' (only states computed). Each state value is an object with keys 'binding_energy_eV' and 'shift_vs_zigzag_pyridinic_eV'. For the protonated state, also include 'protonation_shift_eV' (protonated−bare). For adsorbate states, include 'adsorbate_shift_eV' (adsorbate−bare).
